title: Renderer cache: test stats, invalidation and eviction; document the ranged-arrange eviction
description:
`crates/apricity-engine/src/render.rs` has one test and it covers filters. Nothing checks the `rendered`/`reused` statistics, invalidation on `insert_source` (68), or eviction (128). Eviction keeps only the keys used by the latest `arrange`, so a ranged `arrange(…, Some(range))` drops every render outside the range. `render.rs:113` does a linear `lanes.iter().position` per event. Files with no unit tests: `apricity-sources/src/lib.rs` (496 lines, only the conformance test), `data/src/loader.rs`, `engine/src/arrangement.rs`, `engine/src/decode.rs`, `engine/src/mixer.rs` (only `tests/realtime.rs`), `cli/src/{play,main,render}.rs`. There are no CLI end-to-end tests for `render`, `fmt`, `explain` or `sources`.

Done when: tests assert the cache statistics and invalidation; the ranged-arrange eviction is either fixed or documented and tested; the lane lookup is a map; the CLI has an end-to-end test per subcommand on `examples/iv-of-ab-minor.apr`.
